piezas.titulo: Grammar in context: Routine and immediate needs
texto: Sentence structure and time expressions: in Thai, verbs do not change for person or tense; the time is specified with time expressions that can go at the beginning or at the end of the sentence: «ตอนเช้า» (in the morning), «วันนี้» (today), «ตอนเย็น» (in the evening). Pattern 1: [Subject] + [Verb] + [Object] + [Time]: «ผมกินข้าวตอนเช้า» (I eat in the morning). Pattern 2: [Time] + [Subject] + [Verb]: «วันนี้ฉันนอนที่บ้าน» (I'm sleeping at home today).
